'''Not a Decipher scan.''' This is the Players Committee's card-gallery image of [[Great Shot, Kid!]], made to show the '''PC errata''' wording. It belongs with [[Great Shot, Kid! (PC 2023 D-E1 card)]]; Decipher's printed card is [[Great Shot, Kid!]] (Decipher.com's own scan: [[:File:Tat-L-greatshotkid-decipher-archive.jpg]]).

The image prints: “Deploy on table. If Death Star “blown away”:Whenever you deploy a unique (*) starship to a system location, retrieve 3 Force; Once per during each of your turns you may deploy (for free) a starship from hand or Reserve Deck and reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)” These are the words of the PC errata first published in the [https://web.archive.org/web/20040707195107/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/rulessheet020904.pdf Players Committee ''Star Wars CCG Rules Supplement''] (“Updated 09 Feb 2004”; Internet Archive copy of 7 July 2004). The printed card reads “… once during each of your turns you may deploy (for free) a starship from hand or Reserve Deck and reshuffle; if you just deployed a unique (•) starship to a system location, retrieve 3 Force.”

'''Bottom-right symbol:''' a bronze disc sits in the lower right corner. In the PC's 2007 gallery (swccgpc.com/cards/) it appears on images whose game text was changed to errata wording, for example [[:File:ANH-L-blastthedoorkid-pc2007.gif|Blast The Door, Kid!]] and Chewbacca (A New Hope); cards without errata, such as Attack Run, A Jedi's Concentration and Keeping The Empire Out Forever, have none. A similar disc also appears on some of Decipher.com's own card-list scans (for example [[:File:SE-D-kuat-decipher-archive.gif|Kuat]] and [[:File:JP-D-nalhutta-decipher-archive.gif|Nal Hutta]]), so it is not proof of a PC image on its own.

Source: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071203111903/http://www.swccgpc.com/cards/tatooine/ls/greatshotkid.gif greatshotkid.gif] in the Players Committee card gallery at swccgpc.com (Internet Archive, 3 December 2007) (367×506). This wiki file is a flush crop of it (350×490, corner pads bleached white), uploaded 25 September 2026 under the misleading name Tatooine-L-greatshotkid-decipher-archive.gif and moved to this name on 12 November 2026 (the old name redirects here).

Linked from the notes of [[Great Shot, Kid! (PC 2023 D-E1 card)]] and [[Great Shot, Kid!]].
